{{Top|leg}}
The '''Back Door''' was a stable route through the [[Black hole/Legends|black holes]] of [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]]. Despite being stable, it was still dangerous as the proximity of the black holes stressed [[Starship/Legends|starships]] as they traveled through the route.
